trump hits bbc with lawsuit over jan 6 speech editing president trump sued the bbc on monday seeking 10 billion in damages for alleging defamation over how a documentary aired shortly before the 2024 election edited a speech he delivered on jan 6 2021 why it matters it marks the third lawsuit the president has waged against a media company while in office trump filed a 15 billion lawsuit against the new york times in september and refiled the case the following month after the original complaint was dismissed for being unnecessarily long he sued the wall street journal in july over its reporting about his purported contribution to jeffrey epsteins birthday book driving the news the suit filed in federal court in miami florida accuses the bbc of one count of defamation and one of violating floridas floridas deceptive and unfair trade practices act trumps legal team is seeking a jury trial and 5 billion in damages for each count catch up quick two top bbc leaders resigned following criticism about the documentary edit that was revealed in an internal memo leaked by the telegraph the memo which raised concerns about bbcs impartiality drew swift condemnation from the white house a lawyer for trump sent a letter to bbc threatening a 1 billion defamation suit unless the british broadcaster issued a retraction an apology and compensation a few days later bbc formally apologized to president trump but did not indicate that it would compensate the president as he had demanded zoom in the 33page lawsuit alleges it would have been impossible for bbcs journalists and producers to splice together two distinct parts of the speech from nearly 55 minutes apart unless they were acting intentionally such a dramatic distortion could never have occurred by accident it adds what theyre saying a spokesperson for his legal team in a monday night email accused the british broadcaster of intentionally maliciously and deceptively doctoring his speech in a brazen attempt to interfere in the 2024 presidential election the other side a bbc spokesperson said after trump threatened to sue the outlet that while it sincerely regrets the manner in which the video clip was edited we strongly disagree there is a basis for a defamation claim representatives for the bbc did not immediately respond to axios monday evening request for comment zoom out the president has upped his legal battles against media companies over the past decade as his political career has taken off last year he sued des moines register abc and cbs the latter two organizations both agreed to multimilliondollar settlements context in the us there is a very high legal bar for people in power to meet in order to win a defamation case against a media company the bbc would likely argue in court that the edit was not conducted with actual malice and that the documentary didnt harm the presidents reputation as it never aired in the us what to watch whether the presidents lawsuit against the bbc inspires him to challenge more foreign broadcasters in addition to us media companies editors note this article has been updated with additional details throughout

a small victory in ohio quietly almost imperceptibly an election triumph in a rural ohio area resonates louder as a victory for trans representation amy heutmaker is a mental health counselor who moved from new york in 2024 to be with her wife in russell township a sparsely populated part of geauga county southeast of cleveland at first she was apprehensive about running for the position of township trustee due to her lack of political experience and the conservative lean of the voters in the area still she threw her hat into the ring after announcing she would run she was met with an online harassment campaign that gained momentum in the wake of charlie kirks murder on september 10th crude comments and death threats followed it got so bad that amy had to pull down all her social media and the russell township police routinely sent patrols to watch her house amy considered pulling out of the race but it was her father who convinced her to keep running by reminding amy that she had wanted to be in politics since she was young and as for worrying about the pushback she encountered he told her dont let the assholes win she also made the somewhat pragmatic decision not to make her being trans nor lgbtq issues focal points of her campaign the interest in her campaign grew and led to her surprising win in november afterwards amy decided to eschew social media and made it her mission to engage as many people in the township as possible amy heutmaker taking oath of office lets meet our neighbors she said thats what i ran on and people responded to it even people that didnt agree with me when they saw me in the community they knew i was approachable amy has already developed a working relationship with a conservative republican trustee in the county a result of her belief that people act differently once they begin to know each other whether that approach works out in the long run for her remains to be seen in any case amy has succeeded in showing transgender people can run and win elective office even in areas normally hostile to their community she sees her win as a step forward for queer people in general who are sadly underrepresented in government the lgbtq population continues to grow especially with gen z and gen alpha so were not going away were here were queer and we want your vote

10 key benefits of an llc every new business owner should know if youre starting a business and wondering whether you should form an llc youre definitely not alone a lot of people hear that an llc offers protection or tax benefits but those explanations are usually vague so lets break down the benefits of an llc in simple english without legal jargon and with real examples that make sense no matter what type of business youre starting this guide walks through the major advantages of an llc including asset protection tax flexibility credibility and other benefits that many new business owners dont realize theyre missing out on whether youre freelancing selling online consulting or running a service business understanding these llc advantages can help you decide if forming an llc is worth it what is an llc and why do people choose it an llc limited liability company is a business structure that legally separates you from your business this means the company becomes its own entity with its own bank account taxes and responsibilities the biggest reason people choose this structure is simple protection when you run your business as a sole proprietor you personally take on every risk the business faces but with an llc you create a shield between your personal life and your business life that leads us right into the most important benefit 1 personal liability protection the 1 benefit of an llc this is the main reason so many small business owners form an llc if your company ever faces legal problems or debt your personal assets are protected this includes your car your house your savings and personal bank accounts your personal property without an llc all of those things could be targeted in a lawsuit because you and the business are considered the same with an llc the business stands on its own this is called limited liability protection and its one of the strongest advantages of an llc compared to a sole proprietorship 2 passthrough taxation simple and flexible taxes by default llcs use a tax setup called passthrough taxation this means the llc itself doesnt pay federal income taxes instead the profits pass through to you and you report them on your personal tax return this avoids corporate doubletaxation and keeps your annual taxes much simpler many new business owners prefer llcs because this tax setup feels familiar and easy to manage this tax treatment is one of the biggest llc tax benefits and is ideal for freelancers contractors online sellers and service providers 3 flexible tax options you can choose how the llc is taxed one of the leastknown benefits of an llc is that you can choose how its taxed yes choose besides the default tax setup you can elect for your llc to be taxed as an scorporation often used to reduce selfemployment taxes a ccorporation useful for larger companies with reinvested profits most small business owners eventually ask should my llc be taxed as an scorp you dont get this kind of flexibility with a sole proprietorship this is part of what makes llcs so customizable for business growth 4 more business credibility your company looks legit like it or not people judge professionalism quickly when your business shows up as yourbusiness llc it looks established and trustworthy an llc can help you attract better clients work with vendors more easily qualify for business credit look more serious than a random side hustle credibility is a major benefit of forming an llc especially if youre working with clients renting space or applying for contracts 5 easy to set up and maintain compared to a corporation people sometimes assume forming an llc is complicated or expensive in reality its one of the easier business structures to maintain llcs do not require a board of directors annual shareholder meetings complicated corporate records most states only require a simple annual report and many llcs can be formed in under an hour this simplicity is one of the most underrated llc benefits 6 supports one owner or many owners an llc can be structured as a singlemember llc just you a multimember llc you partners you can divide ownership however you want you can also add partners later without needing to create a brandnew entity this flexibility is something sole proprietorships dont offer and corporations handle in a much more rigid way 7 better separation of personal and business finances once you form an llc you open a business bank account and from that point on you keep personal and business money separate this protects your liability shield and makes taxes way easier because your expenses and income are neatly organized many business owners accidentally blur personal and business finances an llc helps you avoid that from day one 8 your business becomes its own legal entity this means your llc can sign its own contracts hire employees open credit accounts lease property operate independently from you this structure gives your business longterm strength even if you step away sell it or bring in partners the llc keeps running 9 easier access to business banking and funding banks and lenders are far more comfortable working with llcs than sole proprietors many banks wont even open a true business account unless you have an llc an ein and proper formation documents this also helps you build business credit which can unlock better interest rates credit cards and funding options down the road 10 protects your business name in your state when you form an llc your business name becomes legally protected within your state no one else can register the same name or something confusingly similar in that state this is one of the most underrated benefits of forming an llc especially if you care about branding or want to expand in the future final thoughts why the benefits of an llc matter whether youre just starting out or leveling up from a side hustle understanding the benefits of an llc helps you protect yourself simplify taxes and build a business that looks and feels professional you dont have to be a big company to take advantage of these benefits llcs were literally designed for small business owners freelancers and everyday entrepreneurs

vidyamadhava lived during the zenith of the vijayanagar empire in the mid14th century around 13501363 ce born into the nilamana family of tulu brahmins in the village of gu likely in modern coastal formal biographies however manuscript evidence reveals his flourishing under royal patronage specifically from mallappa son of bukka raya i r 13561377 ce who administered eastern mysore territories in question was buried in a small corner of page 16 in the riverbend news classified public notices section furthermore a review of that published agenda revealed no mention of a mandatory form required for public speech the agenda for the town council regular meeting found on page 16 in the riverbend news classified public notices section this bureaucratic hurdle effectively barred citizens from participating in a citizen input session that was clearly listed on the docket raising concerns about compliance with florida statute 2860114 which mandates that members of the public be given a reasonable opportunity to be heard on a proposition before a board who is actually running the town beyond the meeting room residents face a digital wall of silence in an era where information is usually a click away the town of mayo remains largely offline the official website townofmayoorg fails to list current town council members or their contact information leaving constituents with no direct line to their elected officials the lack of updated digital infrastructure extends to general information sources as well the mayo wikipedia page currently lists ann murphy as the mayor responsibility elections have been the usual mechanism by which modern representative democracy has operated since the 17th century elections may fill offices in the legislature sometimes in the executive and judiciary and for regional and local government such as cities or towns this process is also used in many other standardized associations public businesses and organizations from clubs to voluntary association and corporations the global use of elections as a tool for selecting representatives in modern representative democracies is in contrast with the practice in the democratic archetype ancient athens where the elections were considered an oligarchic institution and most political offices were filled using allotment which is also known as sortition by which office holders were chosen by lot electoral reform describes the process of introducing fair electoral systems where they are not in place or improving the fairness or effectiveness of existing systems psephology is
